mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.certificate_id AS certificateId, a.certificate_title AS certificateTitle, a.requester_id AS requesterId, a.requester_name AS requesterName, a.reason, a.status, COALESCE(p.real_name, p.username) AS approverName, a.reject_reason AS rejectReason, a.approve_time AS approveTime, a.create_time AS createTime FROM delete_audit a LEFT JOIN admin p ON p.id = a.approver_id ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
